headline: RDW presents Tesla FSD case to EU Technical Committee in Brussels — Nordic regulators (Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Norway) raise concerns over FSD allowing speeding, icy road performance, and driver distraction; Swedish official 'quite surprised' FSD programmed to exceed speed limits; Finnish official questions hands-free driving on icy 80 km/h roads + large-animal collisions; no vote today; Tesla needs 15/27 EU member states for bloc-wide approval; next vote opportunities: July and October 2026

Tesla FSD surpasses 10 billion cumulative miles — Musk's own stated threshold for 'safe unsupervised' self-driving; milestone confirmed by official Tesla X post; in January 2026 Musk revised the threshold upward from 6B to 10B miles after missing 2025 deadline; Electrek cautions 'no magical milestone' auto-unlocks unsupervised FSD, but data target has now been formally crossed
source: Tesla / Electrek / The Verge / Drive Tesla Canada

headline: Unsupervised robotaxi fleet reaches 33+ vehicles with hundreds parked and ready across TX — fleet likely undercounted since crowdsourced tracker misses 50%+ of supervised vehicles; Tesla Robotaxi pricing ~$6.15/ride vs Waymo's $13.93; Dallas and Houston still well below Austin's fleet density but 100s of robotaxi-marked Model Ys staged in both cities; Cybercabs also staged and awaiting deployment authorization

FSD v15 described as ~10x parameter upgrade targeting ~10 billion parameters — next architectural leap after v14.3's ground-up rewrite; Musk confirms v15 is the direct gate for mass robotaxi scale and unsupervised personal FSD; notateslaapp details v15 as a qualitative capability jump, not an incremental update; timeline aligns with Q3–Q4 2026 per Elluswamy

Austin robotaxi fleet begins nighttime unsupervised operations for the first time — service previously restricted to daylight hours (ending mid-afternoon); night ops expansion materially widens Tesla's Operational Design Domain; Dallas and Houston had supported evening unsupervised runs since April launch; confirms neural-net vision stack handling low-light, headlight glare, and reduced pedestrian contrast without human intervention

Tesla Cybercab displayed inside glass box at Miami F1 Grand Prix — 'Autonomy Pop-Up' at Lummus Park ran Apr 29–May 3; Cybertruck towed Cybercab through beachfront crowd marked 'Future is Autonomous'; Miami is confirmed 1H 2026 robotaxi expansion city; follows Optimus appearances at Boston Marathon finish line (Apr 19–20) and Miami Design District (Dec 2025)

Netherlands RDW formally submits EU-wide FSD approval application — regulator moves beyond national greenlight to seek harmonized EU authorization; individual EU member states can still approve independently in parallel; analysts cite EU subscriber ramp as catalyst investors are underpricing; full continental rollout gating on FSD v15 but supervised access expanding now

Tesla amended 10-K reveals $573M in related-party revenue: $430M from xAI (AI compute services) and $143M from SpaceX (vehicle sales) — deepens financial integration across Musk's empire; raises governance questions; revenue flows confirm Tesla-xAI-SpaceX as a unified commercial ecosystem, supporting the SpaceX merger thesis; critics flag conflicts of interest and lack of arm's-length pricing disclosure
